code.text: Periodontal charting — NO VERIFIED LOINC CODE. This is the same named terminology gap carried in UC02a's periodontal-charting DiagnosticReport: no precomposed LOINC code for periodontal charting specifically was found in prior project searches, and CDT confirms periodontal charting is not itself a billable procedure (it lives inside exam codes such as D0180), consistent with it lacking its own LOINC code. Left as text-only pending a proper LOINC terminology browser lookup — not an oversight.

conclusion: Periodontal charting performed at limited oral evaluation, tooth #30 region. Findings support the periapical abscess and non-restorable tooth diagnoses; charting data referenced in the referral to Austin Oral Surgery and retrieved by them via support-a-pull (Interaction 2).
